newsitem.title: CANADA: Royal Plastics to acquire Ecopal stake.
newsitem.headline: Royal Plastics to acquire Ecopal stake.

text.p: Royal Plastics Group Ltd said on Tuesday it signed a definitive agreement to acquire 80 percent of the issued and outstanding shares of privately held Ecopal Technologies Inc, an Ontario-based plastic recycling company.
Royal Plastics said it will close the acquisition by September 30 and rename the company Royal Ecoproducts Ltd.

Ecopal manufactures plastic products made from recycled, post-industrial and consumer plastic waste and holds multiple patents for the use of recycled plastic to manufacture products like material handling systems and building products.
Royal Plastics said Ecopal's founder and president Herbert Hoedl will continue to manage the business.
